summary: Validated the new Daily Job Reports module end-to-end. Backend pytest 54/54 PASS — created /app/backend/tests/test_daily_reports.py with 15 new tests covering /api/daily-reports CRUD (POST returns full doc with id+created_at and no _id leak; nested arrays for masci_crews/subcontractors/visitors/equipment/materials/activities/photos all preserved on round-trip GET; list summary returns photo_count=6, crew_count=2, sub_count=1, visitor_count=1; weather_snapshots[1].temp_f=80 preserved), 422 validation for each of project_name|location|prepared_by|report_date when missing, 404 on GET/DELETE of unknown id, DELETE→GET 404 verification, plus regression smoke that /api/inspections|/api/meetings|/api/jhas|/api/incidents GET still 200 and a fresh inspection POST still returns 200 with cleanup. Existing pytest test_inspections.py + test_meetings_jhas.py + test_incidents.py still 100% green (39/39). Frontend live preview probed: Hub shows EXACTLY 5 tiles in the spec'd order [hub-tile-daily, hub-tile-inspections, hub-tile-meetings, hub-tile-jha, hub-tile-incidents] with hub-new-daily NewBtn → /daily/new. /daily dashboard renders new-daily-btn, share-daily ShareFormDialog, lang-es toggle, h1='Today's site activity, captured.' and 1 existing report row (the smoke-test seed). /daily/new renders all 18 expected testids: job-picker-trigger, use-gps-btn, refresh-weather-btn, photos-status (default 'Add at least 6 more photo(s)'), all 6 RepeatBlock add buttons (crew-add|sub-add|visitor-add|equipment-add|material-add|activity-add), input-project-name|input-location|input-report-date|input-prepared-by, submit-top-btn|submit-bottom-btn, prepared-by-sig-canvas, superintendent-sig-canvas. crew-add click adds editable crew-row-0 with a working crew-remove-0. Empty-form Submit triggers sonner toast 'Project Name is required' (validate() chain works). lang-es swaps form to Spanish ('Reporte Diario del Trabajo'). /daily/submit renders publicMode (back-link absent) with the same Spanish h1 (lang state persists across routes — i18n provider is global). Regression: /inspect/new, /meetings/new, /jha/new, /incidents/new all still load with a JobPicker present. /daily/<id> renders all 11 sections, print-btn visible, MASCI logo at top, and the .print-only footer block contains the literal string 'MASCI General Contractors Inc.' + 'No Shortcuts · No Exceptions' + '5752 South Ridgewood Avenue' + 'Port Orange, FL 32127-6442' + '386-322-4500 · safety@mascigc.com' (verified via DOM scan since print-only is display:none on screen). No console errors, only the harmless Canvas2D willReadFrequently warning from SignaturePad (carry-over, not new).
action_items: [Optional carry-over from iter6] /app/backend/server.py is now 675 lines covering 5 modules — definitely worth splitting into routers/{inspections,meetings,jhas,incidents,daily_reports}.py with a shared models module. Not blocking but file size is past the 700-line guideline.
[Optional] All 5 *Create models use ConfigDict(extra='allow'), which is fine during form evolution but should be tightened once schemas stabilize so unknown fields don't silently persist.
critical_code_review_comments: All 5 POST endpoints (inspections, meetings, jhas, incidents, daily-reports) correctly call doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one and use {_id:0} projection on list/get — verified empirically across 54 tests, no _id leaks anywhere.

DailyReport list endpoint correctly computes photo_count/crew_count/sub_count/visitor_count from the embedded arrays via {_id:0, photos:1, masci_crews:1, subcontractors:1, visitors:1, ...} projection — verified counts match the POST payload.
NewDailyReport.validate() enforces project_name, location, prepared_by, photos.length >= photo_min (default 6), and prepared_by_signature — all 5 paths produce the spec'd toasts.

RepeatBlock helper in NewDailyReport.jsx is well-factored: 6 sections (crews/subs/visitors/equipment/materials/activities) all share the same repeat-row component with consistent {testIdBase}-add / {testIdBase}-row-{i} / {testIdBase}-remove-{i} / {testIdBase}-{field}-{i} testid scheme. Clean.

Weather is fetched client-side via fetchDailyWeather (Open-Meteo public API) and persisted as weather_snapshots[] on the report doc — backend stays integration-free, which is correct for a free public API. Verified weather_snapshots round-trip preserves time/temp_f/condition/precip_in/humidity_pct/wind_mph.
View page (/daily/:id) print-only footer block is wired correctly: contains MASCI company name, slogan, address, csz, phone, and email. Visible in print preview, hidden on screen (display:none).

Lang toggle persists across routes (verified: switched to ES on /daily/new, then /daily/submit also rendered ES h1 'Reporte Diario del Trabajo'). UI labels are translated; user-entered data is stored as typed (no swap-back needed for daily reports per spec).
Hub now correctly counts daily reports in addition to the other 4 modules and shows '0' or N in the tile sub-text.

success_rate.backend: 100% (54/54 pytest, including 15 new daily-report tests + 39 carry-over)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on probed surfaces: Hub (5 tiles in spec order), DailyReportsDashboard (new/share/lang/h1/1 row), NewDailyReport (18 testids + crew add/remove + empty-submit toast + ES translation + photos-status default), publicMode submit (no back-link), ViewDailyReport (11 sections + print-btn + MASCI print-only footer), regression on 4 other /new routes.

seed_data_creation: test_daily_reports.py creates 2 TEST_DR_* daily reports per run (1 module-scoped used across 3 tests + cleaned up in teardown; 1 TEST_DR_DEL_ created and explicitly deleted; 4 TEST_DR_VAL_ creates that fail with 422 so no DB rows). 1 inspection TEST_DR_REG_INSP created and deleted in regression test. No residual TEST_ data after pytest finishes. The 1 daily-report row created via curl during smoke test (id 4cab04c6-…) is left in DB intentionally so the dashboard list view has something to render — fine to leave or clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (~5s, 54/54). New testids confirmed live on /daily/new: job-picker-trigger, use-gps-btn, refresh-weather-btn, photos-status, crew-add, sub-add, visitor-add, equipment-add, material-add, activity-add, crew-row-{i}, crew-remove-{i}, crew-{field}-{i} (and same prefix for sub/visitor/equipment/material/activity), input-project-name, input-project-number, input-location, input-report-date, input-report-number, input-prepared-by, input-superintendent, input-incident-notes, input-general-notes, schedule-delays-{yes|no}, weather-impact-{yes|no}, safety-incidents-{yes|no}, injuries-reported-{yes|no}, prepared-by-sig-canvas, superintendent-sig-canvas, submit-top-btn, submit-bottom-btn, weather-snap-{i}. Hub testids: hub-tile-{daily|inspections|meetings|jha|incidents}, hub-new-{daily|inspection|meeting|jha|incident}. Dashboard: new-daily-btn, share-daily-*, daily-row-{id}, view-{id}, delete-{id}, empty-state, empty-cta. View: print-btn, .print-only block. To exercise full end-to-end submit through the UI you'd need to: pick a job, fill location+prepared_by, draw on prepared-by-sig-canvas, upload 6 photos via PhotoUpload, then click submit-bottom-btn. Faster path is the API: `POST /api/daily-reports` with the payload built by test_daily_reports.py::_full_payload — verified working with full nested array round-trip.
rca of the issue: No bugs identified this iteration. The Daily Job Reports module is shipped, fully wired, and matches the review-request spec across all 12 acceptance items: (1) backend CRUD ✓, (2) backend regression ✓, (3) Hub 5 tiles + daily first ✓, (4) /daily dashboard ✓, (5) /daily/new with all 11 sections + JobPicker + GPS + Refresh Weather + photos-status + 6 RepeatBlocks ✓, (6) validation toasts ✓, (7) full POST round-trip with nested arrays preserved ✓, (8) /daily/:id with print-btn + MASCI print-only footer ✓, (9) bilingual ES on /daily/new ✓, (10) /daily, /daily/new, /daily/submit (publicMode), /daily/:id all routed ✓, (11) regression on 4 existing /new routes ✓.
